evidence.observation: Close-up of X shows a long, slender, downward-angled fish with the red eye at the lower/front end; the same elongate body outline and head proportions appear in A close-ups at -3.298 and -3.132, not in B close-ups.
evidence.distinguishes_because: This favors X=A (C2) over X=B (C1), because the shape matches A rather than B.

evidence.distinguishes_because: Ties the final-time Y to B, which is complementary to X=A and supports C2 over C1.
